summary: Scorpio Tankers Inc. filed a Form 6-K disclosing agreements to sell four LR2 product tankers (STI Broadway, STI Condotti, STI Winnie, STI Lauren) for $285.8 million aggregate; a letter of intent to purchase two newbuilding MR product tankers at $46.25 million each; and intention to prepay $367.8 million in secured debt due 2028, cancelling undrawn revolver capacity. Vessel sales expected to close Q2/Q3 2026. The company is repaying all 2028 maturities, terminating those credit facilities. What to watch: execution of definitive documentation for the newbuild LOI and completion of vessel sales; risk-arb focuses on delivery timing and financing.
